claim.statement: GitLab's current documentation says CI/CD flow execution reads .gitlab/duo/agent-config.yml from the project's default branch and can configure the image, setup script, network policy and cache; setup scripts run before the Secure Runtime and can access flow environment variables and identity tokens.

source.title: Configure flow execution
source.locator: Configure CI/CD execution, Create the agent configuration file and Configure setup scripts

limitations: Setup scripts execute outside the Secure Runtime boundary and therefore cannot be described as sandboxed by that control.
The default-branch configuration source gives repository maintainers authority over the execution environment and requires separate branch-protection analysis.
unknowns: The selected image, setup commands, network policy, cache, variables and branch protections are unknown.
The exact agent-config schema and behavior at GitLab 18.8.0-ee are not pinned by this rolling page.
